title: StoreKit: Subscription Entitlement Logic
hints: Filter out revoked and expired transactions first.
Map product ids to tiers and take the maximum (`Comparable` enum).
The renewal date is the latest expiry among active subscriptions.
jsBridge: StoreKit 2 gives verified transactions; your app decides access, like a web app checking a subscription status from Stripe webhooks, except the source of truth is the signed on-device receipt (`Transaction.currentEntitlements`).

compass.q: Stripe webhooks tell your server about subscriptions. Where does an iOS app get the truth, and can it work offline?
Grace period, billing retry, refunded, upgraded mid-period: which transactions still grant access?
Checking entitlements on device vs App Store Server API on your backend: which do you trust for server-side features?
Family Sharing: does a family member's purchase grant access? How do you know (`ownershipType`)?
